spans.s:
Almost,Ⓒadv.ⒹprAya, BUyizWa, kalpa, affixed to adj.; ‘a(lmost) dead’ mftakalpa, mftaprAya; ‘when the night had a(lmost) worn away’ kzIRaBUyizWAyAM kzapAyAM; ‘it is a(lmost) dawn now’ aDunA praBAta-prAyA-kalpA SarvarI.
Ⓑ
 2 prAyaH, prAyaSaH, ‘a(lmost) all’ prAyaH sarve.
Ⓑ
 3 (With num.) ex. by Asanna, upa, in comp.; upa-Asanna-daSAH &c.
Alms,Ⓒs.ⒹBakzya, BikzA, BikzAdAnaM; ‘beg a(lms)’ BikzAwanaM kf 8 U, Bikz-yAc 1 A; ‘a(lms)-giving’ BikzAdAnaM, tyAgaH; ‘a(lms) house’ anATagfhaM, BikzAgehaM; ‘a(lms) man’ BikzukaH, BikzASin m.
